en.intro: Review the plan, run the analysis in an isolated environment, and receive the chart with execution evidence.
en.proofs:
Input data.
Executed code.
Verifiable result.
en.clearTrail: A clear trail, from start to finish.
en.csvPlaceholder: Upload a spreadsheet or use the sample
en.sampleQuestion: Sum revenue by channel and show a chart.
en.localMode: Local rehearsal — fixed plan, no AI
en.vultrEnabled: Vultr — question and columns sent to the model
en.privacy: Use synthetic data at this stage. In Vultr mode, the question and column names are sent to the model; spreadsheet values stay on the server and in the sandbox.
en.emptyTitle: An analysis starts with a plan.
en.emptyText: See what will happen and inspect the code before allowing execution.
en.validationHint: The sum and row count were checked. Review whether the analysis answers your question.
en.principle1Text: The plan is available for review.
en.principle2: Each task has its own environment.
en.principle2Text: No network, no keys, and defined limits.
en.footer: SheetKeeper · preparation prototype for Vultr AgentRush
en.footerPending: Local tests verified. Vultr execution is still pending.
en.localAvailable: Local rehearsal available. No Vultr execution has been verified.
en.awaitDocker: You can review the plan now. Execution awaits Docker and the sandbox image.
en.runReady: The environment will be destroyed afterward. The containment test runs an isolated infinite loop for up to 3 seconds.
en.runBlocked: No code will run outside the sandbox. Start Docker and build the image to continue.
en.sampleLoaded: Synthetic sample loaded. Prepare the plan for review.
en.csvTooLarge: Choose a CSV up to 200 KB.
en.csvLoaded: Spreadsheet loaded. Check the data before preparing the plan.
en.planReady: Plan ready. Inspect the code before running.
en.completed: Execution complete and environment destroyed. Check the result.
en.contained: Loop stopped. Environment destroyed. Create another task to demonstrate recovery.
en.failed: The task did not produce a validated result.
en.sampleSummary: Sum revenue by channel and validate the sum of groups.

es.proofs:
Datos de entrada.
Código ejecutado.
Resultado verificable.

es.localMode: Ensayo local — plan fijo, sin IA
es.vultrEnabled: Vultr — pregunta y columnas enviadas al modelo
es.privacy: Usa datos sintéticos en esta etapa. En modo Vultr, la pregunta y los nombres de las columnas se envían al modelo; los valores permanecen en el servidor y en el sandbox.

es.principle2Text: Sin red, sin claves y con límites definidos.
